title: Early Access Launch Briefing
label: Launch readiness
summary: WARDOGS entered Steam Early Access on September 10, 2026. Community-marked records remain separate from values checked against the public Early Access build while individual items are reviewed.

changes.description: WARDOGS entered Steam Early Access on September 10, 2026.
Community records remain clearly labeled until each value is checked against the public Early Access build.

title: Closed Beta 02 Opened to More Players
label: Beta
summary: The pre-launch beta moved into a broader access period for final scale testing. Observations from that build may differ from Early Access values.

changes.description: Server scale, browser, VOIP, entitlements and queue behavior were part of the announced test focus.

title: WARDOGS Launch Date Announced
label: Announcement
summary: BULKHEAD announced the September 10 Early Access launch and described the supporter edition as cosmetic support rather than cash or power monetization.

changes.description: Official communication states that in-game cash and gold bars will not be sold for real money.
